LESSON: ISLAMIC

Grade: PP1
Subject: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
Strand: MORAL
Topic 4.1.3: Islamic

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Islamic. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

Big question: How do we greet?

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

By the end of this lesson, you will be able to:

1. appreciate the importance of using Islamic greeting in daily life
2. apply Islamic greeting appropriately while interacting with others using the Islamic greeting

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

1. appreciate the importance of using Islamic greeting in daily life
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to appreciate the importance of using Islamic greeting in daily life. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

2. apply Islamic greeting appropriately while interacting with others using the Islamic greeting
   In this part of the lesson, you learn to apply Islamic greeting appropriately while interacting with others using the Islamic greeting. Think about how you can do this at school and at home in Kenya.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: Greet others politely using Islamic greetings you have learned.

Example 2: Keep yourself clean before prayer, just as you wash hands before eating.

Example 3: Share with a friend one good manner you practised today.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Islamic.
2. Explain Islamic to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Islamic.
4. Show that you can: appreciate the importance of using Islamic greeting in daily life
5. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Islamic. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: How do we greet?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. appreciate the importance of using Islamic greeting in daily life
2. apply Islamic greeting appropriately while interacting with others using the Islamic greeting

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
